pages.text: Growing on some spruce trees, you can find Pine Nuts growing from the leaves. You can replant these nuts to grow back into trees for a renewable source of both wood and Pine Nuts.
Found in patches throughout the Taiga, you can find Elven Sweet Berry Bushes. Once fully grown, you can pick the berries off them by right-clicking on the bush.

Throughout taiga biomes, Wild Garlic can be found sprouting from the ground which can be broken to produce Bulbs of Garlic. You can replant these bulbs onto Farmland to replenish your supply of Garlic.
Throughout taiga biomes, Wild Mint can be found sprouting from the ground. Using Bone Meal on this plant will have a chance to spread it, renewing your supply of the resource!
